prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to describe the time behavior of technical systems from various domains using ordinary differential equations.
Students possess the competence to analyze the properties of such models and to select and implement suitable algorithms for simulation based on them.

syllabus_topics: Linear and nonlinear models of dynamic systems
Analytical and numerical solution methods for simulating system behavior
Concept of state and state-space representation
Concept of stability for linear dynamic systems
Accompanying practical course to the lecture with special consideration of mechatronics
